prompt:
Translate the puzzle into a CSP. Output only a JSON object; do not solve it.
Each variable is one named person, object, room or cell whose value must be found. Map each variable name to a flat list of allowed values, with no nested lists. Do not create variables named 'name', 'value', or 'domain'.
Use only these constraints: {"type":"alldiff","vars":["A","B"]}, {"type":"eq","a":"A","b":"red"}, {"type":"neq","a":"A","b":"B"}. For neq, b may also be a domain value. Keep numeric values as numbers.
Example: 'Ana and Bo choose different colours, red or blue. Ana chooses red.'
{"variables":{"Ana":["red","blue"],"Bo":["red","blue"]},"constraints":[{"type":"alldiff","vars":["Ana","Bo"]},{"type":"eq","a":"Ana","b":"red"}]}
Puzzle:
Six students -- Hana, Ivo, Jun, Kai, Lia, Moe -- finished a quiz in positions 1 to 6, with no ties. Jun finished first. Ivo finished last. Lia was not third, not fourth and not fifth. Hana was neither fourth nor fifth. Moe was not fourth.
